evidence: Bandera — NPSOT states the wild Texas range begins in western Bandera County and extends westward.
Edwards — a documented NPSOT photo-contest field record places wild Salvia greggii at Kickapoo Caverns State Park, Edwards County.
Kew confirms Texas as native, but a third explicit project-target county native occurrence has not yet been documented to the project standard.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Only two explicit project-target counties are documented strongly enough so far. Do not count cultivated Austin/Williamson occurrences or infer unnamed western counties.
target_zone_range.guardrail: No county presence inferred from source-pool membership or cultivated records.

morphology.look_here_first: Recognize the woody evergreen-ish shrub first: many short branches carry small aromatic oval/elliptic leaves and comparatively large showy flowers that can vary from red and pink to white.
diagnostic_traits: small aromatic elliptic to obovate leaves
showy relatively large flowers with strong color variation
dry rocky western Edwards Plateau/Trans-Pecos habitat

confusers.separator: S. greggii has larger showier flowers and generally larger less-hairy leaves; S. ballotiflora has tiny blue-purple flowers and small hairy rough leaves.

installation_guardrail: Do not install until the range hold is resolved and Calvin approves.
